measurement.reason: unmeasured on purpose, and no substitute number is offered. The matcher is narrow by construction — the pattern set is two conjunctions, each requiring a specific binary at the end of the executable path together with the flag or the words that mean "stop recording" — but nothing in this repository has run it over a real log population, so there is no false-positive count to report and a rule with no count is `unmeasured`, not `quiet`. Arm it against an inventory of hosts that ship `linux.process_creation` and record the count in this block before it is expected to page anyone.
